client: KhairKhwah, family planning for FCDO’s DAFPAK programme
title: Headlines of Tomorrow, digital expansion
summary: The launch film asked whether tomorrow’s headlines would be better than today’s. The digital expansion carried that question to where conversations happen online: live sessions on X, X posts and Instagram content built around the Headlines of Tomorrow idea.
note: My role: the digital expansion across X Spaces, X posts and Instagram. The launch film was produced separately.

client: Telenor Pakistan, Monthly Prime summer campaign
title: Tension Ko Smash Karo
summary: Expensive bundles are a summer headache. Tension Ko Smash Karo turned a price offer into a mood: smash the tension, full time aesh karo. Brand films led, and a wave of influencer content through May and June carried the line into people’s own feeds.

client: SPARC, Society for the Protection of the Rights of the Child
title: Owners and Workers, Stand United
summary: In Pakistan’s brick kilns, exploitation thrives. This series asked a different question: what if owners and workers broke bonded labour together, building a future where both sides prosper?

title: Jurro Rabb Se, Jurro Sab Se
summary: A Ramadan to Eid platform built on one tension: we stay endlessly connected horizontally and forget the vertical connection. Ramadan reconnects you with the Creator; Eid carries that strength outward to family and community. Ashra, Jumah and Taaq Raatein series for the month, then an Eid animation to close the arc.

images.caption: The big idea, Jurro Rabb Se

title: Parwarish Har Qadam
summary: Children learn from what parents do, not what they say. Everyday reminders that urge parents to nurture at every step.

title: Never Miss a Beat
summary: In healthcare, every second counts. Intercom solutions shown as quiet infrastructure that helps hospitals orchestrate care with precision, so patients get attention when it matters.
